title: Known limitation: for naive Bayes, text normalisation does not stop an adaptive attacker

invariants.description: The default attack must still evade the undefended naive-Bayes filter (observed 17/86 = 19.8%).
A NEW attack against the normalising naive-Bayes filter must still succeed on ≥ 10% (observed 14/86 = 16.3%), although replay suggests 3.5%.
The adaptive reduction must NOT be significant (observed McNemar p = 0.25). If it becomes significant, check whether the attack regressed before concluding the defense improved.

rationale: Same defense, different model: replay against normalising naive Bayes drops success from 17 to 3 of 86, but an adaptive attacker gets 14 of 86. A defense result does not transfer between classifiers, and replay overstates robustness.
